SELECT
FROM workflow_task_record wtr INNER JOIN workflow_task_instance wti ON wti.id = wtr.instance_id AND wti.is_deleted = false WHERE wtr.is_deleted = false AND wtr.status != 'success' AND NOT (wtr.status = 'failed' AND COALESCE(wtr.retry_count, 0) > #{maxRetryCount}) AND wtr.instance_id IS NOT NULL AND wtr.instance_id != '' AND wti.status NOT IN ('success', 'cancelled')
AND wtr.source_id = #{id}
ORDER BY wtr.instance_id, wtr.index

SELECT
FROM workflow_task_record WHERE is_deleted = false AND (source_type, source_id) IN ( SELECT DISTINCT source_type, source_id FROM workflow_task_record WHERE status != 'success' AND is_deleted = false AND NOT (status = 'failed' AND COALESCE(retry_count, 0) > #{maxRetryCount}) ) AND NOT (status = 'failed' AND COALESCE(retry_count, 0) > #{maxRetryCount})
AND source_id = #{id}
ORDER BY source_type, source_id, index

SELECT wtr.source_type, wtr.dict_basic_id, db.name as dict_basic_name, count(1) as errorCount FROM workflow_task_record as wtr left join dict_basic as db on wtr.dict_basic_id = db.id and db.is_deleted = false WHERE wtr.is_deleted = FALSE and wtr.retry_count > #{maxRetryCount} and wtr.source_type !='' and wtr.dict_basic_id != '' AND wtr.status = 'failed' GROUP BY wtr.source_type , wtr.dict_basic_id, db.name
